_comment: The on-camera candidate: a real, live MCP server whose job Clembot ALREADY
does. Exa fetches a web page and returns readable text, which url-unfurler
and feed-fetcher already cover, so the doorman declines it as redundant.
That is the point of this fixture: the decline is about FIT, not safety. No
grade is involved and none is needed, which is why scorecard_called is
false. The redundancy check short-circuits first, so this path never forms
an opinion about whether the server is any good.
Do NOT reuse WebZum as the example here. An earlier version of this demo
did, and the comment outlived the change while still describing WebZum as
well-behaved. It is not: webzum.com/api/mcp grades F on a hard fail, audit
b8535ab0 of 2026-09-03. It demonstrates the opposite case to this one.
Chosen against the REAL roster, not invented. Clembot has url-unfurler and
feed-fetcher, and three more agents holding WebFetch, so the overlap list
writes itself from names Clemens actually runs.
needed_for: fetch a web page and give me the readable text
how_to_run: DOORMAN_INVENTORY_ROOT=C:/Users/cwan0/Documents/marketing-bootstrap node scripts/vet.mjs https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp --needed-for 'fetch a web page and give me the readable text'
